answer: Anchor each account to one vertex in a stake-weighted trust graph, backed by a refundable bond that only unlocks as independent peers attest to real work across many epochs. A clone fleet cannot cheaply forge that history: every fake must post fresh collateral and wait out its own vesting window, so sybil cost scales linearly with headcount. New identities start ivory-blank at zero weight, and each stake and attestation is written to a crystal-clear public ledger where correlated funding sources expose the farm.
